result.note: Private PMI survey rather than official data; one question on the PMI reading and its expansion threshold.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about India's Purchasing Managers' Index (PMI) readings for March 2026:
items: The HSBC India Services PMI fell from its February level but stayed above the 50-mark that separates expansion from contraction.
The Composite PMI rose to its highest reading in nearly three and a half years.
International orders for services firms reached their second-highest level since the index began tracking them in 2014.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: The Composite PMI dropped to 57.0 from 58.9, its weakest reading in nearly three and a half years, so statement 2 is wrong. The Services PMI slipped to 57.5 from 58.1 as the West Asia conflict weighed on domestic demand, even as foreign orders surged.
questions.source: The HSBC India Services Purchasing Managers’ Index (PMI) fell to 57.5 from February's 58.1, still comfortably above the 50-mark separating expansion from contraction.
